result.markdown:
For a small business in the UK, my overall recommendation would be **Sage Payroll** for a straightforward, standalone payroll system. However, there are a few alternatives that could be better depending on your business.

## My top 5 payroll software recommendations

![Sage Payroll – Simple & Compliant Payroll Software for Small Teams
 – Skunkworks](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nlhLcBDBpk0P93bY_QTKarVXPYIBp2x1koQADDoL80jmuW3QSq9mUoVyfAc8_rE2AvQuD1_1XQ4rzxG1_E3gx7UWAWbDsxntSeAXOKfrzFEuaq0ODU0nt6jtpeJCvuS5LcSwSEFYw2_pOSoOcmOEdeOu4TqmHtc61NE8aQDhj_6MnSRjzO6G4kk2lhYoikh5?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

- From £12/month for five employees.
- PAYE, National Insurance and HMRC submissions.
- Workplace pension support.
- Employee payslips and HR features.

Best for small businesses wanting a reliable standalone system.

[Software review and pricing](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/best-payroll-software-for-uk/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll)

- Designed specifically for payroll.
- HMRC submissions and pension processing.
- Employee self-service portal.
- Good for accountants and businesses running payroll themselves.

Best if payroll is your main requirement.

[Software review](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Small business, big stress – and finding the right balance for success](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/js_DP_ZcJt2b0HYevLiH8RyWaqBcysH-7umi2-OpUv1L_c7R6GqF2ePsaUUNhFEx0xoCJM9UhE2ygbfJvKTZATLo4fmY2I8PpXkEP4z5gNTNS9QARFCTPWNcGDYwVCjusvLzfwG5BpY7OHDvJf-Gvvkz7eUnU1rkY8PEcDFGKBEcxvEb1v6GA_F2cLDI9Uk_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

- Integrated with Xero accounting.
- Payroll and bookkeeping in one place.
- Pension and HMRC reporting support.
- Employee leave management.

Best if you already use Xero.

[Xero comparison](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector | QuickBooks Logo Design – Financial Software Brand Identity – Intuit Accounting Tool – Green Book Icon - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/oPBKHlpW3VRRyCSbZmD52Nilt3jP5kEo8b4ANb2S-u8fQ6QePVB_cvAd6IKOks-js5QWUpymvIunIaun86-JlYhjPau-_Mhp346D7olgKRjyNS79MID_pjj6KHmiIVfhu-wdWRd3KzO8hLOPj0YW2TF6hrwN0i4exabp-2phx1LS7Y32gpTOZFzmWesJom6_?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

- Integrates with QuickBooks accounting.
- Automates payroll calculations.
- HMRC submissions and pension support.
- Useful financial reporting.

Best if you already use QuickBooks.

[QuickBooks review](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/knit-payroll-review/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Employment Hero Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Z6qVhSSYF5CYFaR38tVZ9vpu364SrI1qcU-LhtFo5MrKvM2IIECP5NGDLvCA9qSi3OHN3nIGoWj3sOAoSGJ3TbpMzqye4Jq3Q2-1Ae4X05g3VDo154uJn7RkzUUAY3Xfi51rzm16rZPnUZ2NnrKj1KHaQU4ePGT94fhowd8mNNeyff58VJ3Le5GJh2e89NE4?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Employment Hero**

(Best budget option)

- Free payroll offering.
- HR and employee management.
- Payroll automation.
- Useful for growing teams.

Best if you want to keep software costs down.

[Software review](https://whichpayroll.com/uk/best-payroll-software-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which would I choose?

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 employees | Sage |
| 5–20 employees | Sage or BrightPay |
| 20–50 employees | BrightPay |
| Already using Xero | Xero Payroll |
| Already using QuickBooks | QuickBooks Payroll |
| Want free payroll | Employment Hero |
